items.text: The Naval Conference in London drew a step nearer to its close this afternoon. The printed draft of the entire treaty, barring part of the preamble, was placed before the drafting committee, which is sitting at St. James palace over the holidays. The main thing the committee had to worry about was the question of phraseology, since it is now a matter of putting into a complete grammatical text what has been already made clear in meaning. The draft is practically finished, but it needs pol polishing. - ishing. polishing.
